options.title: Adjust permit issuance to match inspection capacity
options.description: Implement a system that paces permit issuance based on the available inspection capacity. This could involve adjusting the rate of permit issuance to ensure that inspectors are not overwhelmed with a backlog of permits, which could lead to delays in zero-energy verifications.
options.local_fit: This option fits the local context by addressing the observed backlog of permits and extended inspection wait times. By adjusting permit issuance, we can ensure timely verifications.
options.possible_pressure_transfer: If this option is implemented, the pressure could shift from permit holders to the permit issuance system.
options.how_we_would_know: Track the number of permits issued and inspection wait times. A reduction in backlog and wait times indicates success.
options.revisit_or_stop_if: If adjusted permit issuance does not improve inspection wait times, reconsider the approach.

options.title: Learn more about the backlog and wait times
options.description: Conduct a thorough investigation into the causes of the permit backlog and extended inspection wait times. Gather data on permits issued, resources available for inspections, and other factors. Understanding the root causes will enable more targeted solutions.
options.possible_pressure_transfer: This option does not directly shift pressure but provides insights for informed decision-making.
options.how_we_would_know: The success of this option can be measured by the depth and accuracy of the insights gained. Clear causes for the backlog and wait times will provide a solid foundation for implementing effective solutions.
options.revisit_or_stop_if: If the investigation does not yield actionable insights or if the causes are beyond our control, consider alternative options or seek external support.

recommendation.rationale: O1 is recommended due to its focus on addressing the backlog and wait times. By adjusting permit issuance, we can proactively manage inspector workload and reduce pressure on permit holders.
recommendation.would_change_if: If the backlog and wait times are caused by external factors beyond our control, we may need to revisit the recommendation.
